'''Zbigniew Stanisław Marciniak'''  (born 9 April 1952 in [[Warsaw]]) is a Polish mathematician and university teacher. Between 2007–2009 he was an Education vice-secretary and from 2010 until 2012 he was Science Secretary.

== Life ==
He graduated mathematic studies in 1976 on the [[w: pl: Wydział Matematyki, Informatyki i Mechaniki Uniwersytetu Warszawskiego|Department of Mathematic, IT and Mechanics]] of [[Warsaw University]]. In 1982 he was taking a PhD degree in [[Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University]] and postdoctoral degree in 1997. Dr. Marciniak specializes in [[Group theory]] and [[Ring theory]].

From the time of graduation he has been working for Mathematical Institute of [[Warsaw University]], from 1997 in the position of Professor. Since 1996 until 1999 he took the function of deputy head, then until 2005 the function of headmaster of this university. In 2005–2007 he led [[w: pl:Polska Komisja Akredytacyjna|The Polish Accreditation Committee]], next he became a leader of Committee on Teaching of Mathematics [[Polish Academy of Sciences|PAN]]. He takes the participation in the editorial committees of journals "Delta" and "Algebra and Discrete Mathematics", represented Poland in the [[Programme for International Student Assessment|PISA]] coordinated by the [[Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development|OECD]].

On 28 November 2007 he took the position of Secretary of State in [[Ministry of National Education (Poland)|Ministerstwo Edukacji Narodowej]]. On 26 August 2009 he was dismissed from the office. On 31 December 2009 he took the position of Secretary of State in [[Ministry of Science and Higher Education (Poland)|Ministerstwo Nauki i Szkolnictwa Wyższego]]. On 31 January 2012 he was also dismissed.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.nauka.gov.pl/ministerstwo/aktualnosci/aktualnosci/artykul/kierownictwo-mnisw-w-nowym-skladzie/ |title=Zbigniew Marciniak dismissed from the position Secretary of State in Ministry of Science and Higher Education |access-date=2014-02-07 |archive-date=2012-02-07 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120207065832/http://www.nauka.gov.pl/ministerstwo/aktualnosci/aktualnosci/artykul/kierownictwo-mnisw-w-nowym-skladzie/ |url-status=dead }}</ref>

Awarded with [[Cross of Merit (Poland)|Silver Cross of Merit]] and [[Order of Polonia Restituta]].
